letterTitle: Summons: cease land clearing pending review
letterBody: The office has taken note of clearing on your estate. Until the matter is reviewed, every clearing crew you hire will cost half again. Burn again, or reach into land that is not yours, and the police will be the next to call.
letterNote: Attention falls with quiet seasons, and faster if you plant forest back.
secondFire: A second wildfire while the police are here is an arrest.
settleNote: Someone at the district office can make this go away. The papers will notice.
banNoWorkUntil: No clearing, palm planting or harvest until
banUpkeep: Upkeep runs at half, and the bank will not lend against a shut estate.
